description: Elections Commission - S. Rajeswary was Selected as the member of the No. 10 Valathappitty of Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha, A. H. Muhammed Selected as the member of the No. 01 Malwathe of Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha, P. M. Meeramuhaiyadeen was Selected as the member of the No. 02 Veeramunai Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government offices (Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including declarations of selected members to fill positions vacated by resignation, which falls under election-related matters and procedures.
